snippet.title: Packing Shift – Official Gameplay Trailer Chaotic Co-op Physics Game
snippet.description:
Packing Shift is a chaotic co-op warehouse game where teamwork keeps the orders moving — and physics makes everything complicated.

Wishlist Packing Shift on Steam

Unload the truck. Stock the shelves. Pick the orders. Pack the boxes. Tape them up. Ship them out.

Sounds simple.

Until your friends get involved.

Packing Shift turns an ordinary warehouse job into a physics-driven co-op disaster. Work together to keep the shift under control, stack and pack orders as fast as you can, and try not to bring the entire warehouse down in the process.

Teamwork makes the dream work.
Physics makes it complicated.

Packing Shift is coming to PC.
Developed by Pugsy Studios.

#PackingShift #CoopGames #IndieGames
